subject: Animation
title: Phil Tippett: From Stop-Motion to Digital
description: A short lesson to help you apply Phil Tippett: From Stop-Motion to Digital.

hook.text: Phil Tippett animated the AT-AT walkers in The Empire Strikes Back using go-motion, an upgraded stop-motion.

buildup.text: Go-motion added motion blur by slightly moving puppets during exposure, creating smoother movement.

discovery.text: Tippett was hired for Jurassic Park to animate dinosaurs with go-motion techniques.

twist.text: When he saw the CGI tests, Tippett famously told Spielberg: I think I'm extinct.

climax.text: Spielberg kept Tippett on to supervise the CGI dinosaurs, bridging analog artistry and digital tools.

punchline.text: The man who thought he was extinct helped birth a new era.

quiz.question: What did Phil Tippett famously say when he saw the CGI dinosaur tests for Jurassic Park?
options: This is the future of filmmaking
